add.title: Crime in Vatican City
add.summary: Vatican City operates no prison system: the article states there are only a few cells used for pre-trial detention, and persons sentenced to imprisonment by Vatican City serve their time in Italian prisons, with costs covered by Vatican City. Because no domestic prison system exists, there is no trans-specific prisoner-placement policy, trans custody facility, or documented trans-prisoner placement case for this jurisdiction. (Last-resort encyclopedic source; no separate State Department Holy See chapter for 2023/2024 exists.)
